summary: Authoritative inventory of the supported VibeSec v1 public surface. Exact member lists are projected into the domain catalogs.

interfaces.summary: Run the Minimal or Standard profile against a local repository.
interfaces.exit_behavior: 0 clean; 1 policy violation; 2 scanner or verification failure; 3 invalid input.
security_boundaries: container mode is rejected until a complete runner is published
limitations: native full-profile execution is currently supported only on Linux x86_64
compatibility_guarantees: exit categories and sanitized artifact names remain compatible throughout v1.x
interfaces.deprecation_policy: A stable command remains available for the v1 major line; replacement requires prior deprecation guidance.
migration_notes: Use --execution-mode native on currently supported hosts.

interfaces.summary: Preview or initialize a profile or add-on from source or a verified bundle.
configuration: API, fuzzing, and authentication options documented by --help
inputs: trusted local source tree or verified consumer bundle
interfaces.exit_behavior: 0 success; 2 conflict or verification failure; 3 invalid configuration; 4 infrastructure failure.
security_boundaries: never invokes package managers, scanners, application code, Git, or network
limitations: existing conflicting files are reported and never overwritten
compatibility_guarantees: explicit capability answers and conflict behavior remain stable in v1.x
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Stable initializer options require a major version for incompatible removal.
migration_notes: Run without --write first; preserve explicit No answers.

interfaces.summary: Diagnose an installed VibeSec profile without changing it.
interfaces.exit_behavior: 0 healthy; 1 actionable warnings; 2 verification failure; 3 invalid input; 4 infrastructure failure.
limitations: environment-specific scanner availability can remain a warning
compatibility_guarantees: diagnostic codes remain machine-readable and additive in v1.x
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Existing diagnostic meanings are retained throughout v1.x.

interfaces.summary: Verify installed files and provenance without changing the target.
interfaces.exit_behavior: 0 verified; 2 verification failure; 3 invalid input; 4 infrastructure failure.
security_boundaries: does not trust installed executable content as authority
limitations: integrity verification does not prove code safety
compatibility_guarantees: verification failures remain distinct from clean results
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Stable result meanings require a major version for incompatible change.

interfaces.summary: Produce a deterministic, non-mutating installation upgrade plan.
outputs: versioned upgrade plan with conflicts and preservation decisions
interfaces.exit_behavior: 0 no conflicts; 1 review required; 2 verification failure; 3 invalid input; 4 infrastructure failure.
limitations: the operator applies reviewed changes separately
compatibility_guarantees: explicit answers, local changes, and unrelated files are preserved
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Upgrade-plan fields remain compatible through v1.x; additive fields are optional.
migration_notes: Review all reported conflicts before applying an update.

interfaces.summary: List, verify, describe, install, disable, enable, remove, plan, and run verified local extensions.
interfaces.exit_behavior: 0 success; 1 review warning; 2 verification or extension failure; 3 invalid input; 4 infrastructure failure.
limitations: third-party extension code remains separately trusted code
compatibility_guarantees: manifest schema v1 and lifecycle state meanings remain stable
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Extension kinds or permissions require migration guidance before deprecation.
migration_notes: Disabled state is retained during an extension upgrade.

interfaces.summary: Manage deterministic, non-executing guidance for supported coding agents.
interfaces.exit_behavior: 0 success; 1 review warning; 2 verification failure; 3 invalid input; 4 infrastructure failure.
security_boundaries: does not invoke agent CLIs or network
repository text is treated as data
limitations: guidance cannot control an external agent runtime
compatibility_guarantees: contract, adapter, and task IDs remain stable in v1.x
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Adapters and tasks retain explicit migration guidance before removal.
migration_notes: User-authored agent files and disabled adapter state are preserved.

interfaces.summary: Process exit categories for scanning, distribution, lifecycle, and verification commands.
configuration: scanner: 0 clean, 1 policy violation, 2 tool failure, 3 invalid input
lifecycle: 0 success, 1 warnings, 2 verification failure, 3 invalid input, 4 infrastructure failure
interfaces.exit_behavior: A non-clean category is never converted to clean success; parser and infrastructure failures remain distinct.
security_boundaries: fail closed on unknown child exit codes
limitations: individual command help identifies which contract applies
compatibility_guarantees: numeric meanings are frozen for v1.x
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Exit codes cannot be repurposed within v1.x.
migration_notes: Automation must branch on documented categories, not output text.

interfaces.summary: Exact scanner coverage state vocabulary.
configuration: ran: scanner completed the declared scope
not_configured: required opt-in input is absent
outputs: one explicit coverage state per expected scanner
interfaces.exit_behavior: tool_error is non-clean; not_configured is never represented as ran.
security_boundaries: unknown or missing states fail validation
limitations: ran reports execution, not absence of all vulnerabilities
compatibility_guarantees: names and meanings are frozen for v1.x
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Coverage states cannot be removed or repurposed in v1.x.

interfaces.summary: Source, secret, and workflow linting with Trivy, Gitleaks, and actionlint.
interfaces.exit_behavior: Uses the scanner exit-code contract 0 through 3.
security_boundaries: does not execute application code or dependencies
limitations: passive scanners do not prove application security
compatibility_guarantees: profile ID, scanner set, artifact names, and exit categories remain stable in v1.x
interfaces.deprecation_policy: The Minimal profile cannot be removed during v1.x.

interfaces.summary: Minimal plus SAST, dependency analysis, SBOM, IaC, optional image scanning, and finding intelligence.
interfaces.exit_behavior: Uses the scanner exit-code contract 0 through 3.
limitations: bundled SAST rules are narrow high-confidence starters
compatibility_guarantees: profile ID and mandatory artifact/coverage contract remain stable in v1.x
interfaces.deprecation_policy: The Standard profile cannot be removed during v1.x.
migration_notes: Image scanning remains explicitly configured and trusted-event only.

interfaces.summary: Opt-in passive ZAP testing of an explicitly supplied prebuilt application image.
interfaces.exit_behavior: Uses the scanner exit-code contract 0 through 3.
limitations: passive baseline is not comprehensive DAST
compatibility_guarantees: add-on ID and sanitized artifact contract remain stable
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Conditional enforcement and target restrictions cannot be weakened in v1.x.
migration_notes: A missing image remains not_configured, never clean DAST coverage.

interfaces.summary: Opt-in bounded OpenAPI contract testing against an isolated prebuilt API image.
configuration: API target, schema, port, base path, safe-method, policy, and optional auth settings
interfaces.exit_behavior: Uses the scanner exit-code contract 0 through 3.
limitations: only the supplied contract and reachable isolated target are assessed
compatibility_guarantees: add-on ID, strict schema boundary, and sanitized artifact contract remain stable
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Safe defaults and isolation may only become stricter in v1.x.

interfaces.summary: Opt-in bounded active API fuzzing and inert injection-marker testing.
interfaces.exit_behavior: Uses the scanner exit-code contract 0 through 3.
limitations: not a general-purpose fuzzer or exploit framework
compatibility_guarantees: explicit opt-in and bounded execution remain mandatory
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Safety gates cannot be weakened in v1.x.

interfaces.summary: Optional bearer-authenticated comparison for passive DAST and OpenAPI testing.
inputs: opaque bearer token scoped to the scanner step
outputs: redacted correlated findings and authentication evidence
interfaces.exit_behavior: Scanner, parser, redaction, publication, and cleanup failures remain non-clean.
limitations: supports only the documented bearer model
compatibility_guarantees: secret names, never secret values, may be retained by migration
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Redaction and failure preservation cannot be weakened in v1.x.
migration_notes: Existing secret names are preserved; secret values are never read by migration.

interfaces.summary: The versioned project questionnaire and security-capability evidence registry.
interfaces.exit_behavior: Unknown fields, missing answers, or inconsistent evidence fail validation.
security_boundaries: explicit No is never converted to Yes
repository answers do not execute code
limitations: questionnaire answers are operator assertions
compatibility_guarantees: existing IDs and explicit answers remain stable in v1.x
interfaces.deprecation_policy: A capability ID requires migration guidance before deprecation.
migration_notes: Preserve every explicit answer, including No.

interfaces.summary: Pinned scanner and supporting security-tool identities.
inputs: repository data or explicitly configured isolated target
outputs: raw private scanner results consumed by trusted normalizers
interfaces.exit_behavior: Unavailable or failing scanners remain tool_error and non-clean.
security_boundaries: checksums, signatures, or immutable digests are verified before use
raw outputs are not public artifacts
limitations: tool support is platform-specific
compatibility_guarantees: scanner IDs remain stable; versions may receive reviewed compatible updates
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Removing a scanner from a stable profile requires deprecation and migration guidance.

interfaces.summary: Normalized findings, correlation groups, and priority records.
interfaces.exit_behavior: Malformed scanner input is a parser failure, never a clean result.
security_boundaries: unknown fields rejected where schemas are strict
limitations: correlation is deterministic evidence grouping, not proof of exploitability
compatibility_guarantees: schema v1 required fields and fingerprint semantics remain stable
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Deprecated fields remain readable with explicit migration guidance.

interfaces.summary: Sanitized scan artifacts and their publication boundary.
configuration: required artifact set varies only by documented profile
interfaces.exit_behavior: Final artifacts preserve the originating non-clean category and stale output is removed.
security_boundaries: raw scanner output is private and deleted
artifact text is bounded and redacted
limitations: reports can still disclose repository-relative paths and dependency names
compatibility_guarantees: mandatory names and meanings remain stable in v1.x
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Artifact removal requires a major version or a compatible migration period.

interfaces.summary: Observe, new, and all enforcement plus independent profile baselines and suppressions.
interfaces.exit_behavior: 0 no violation; 1 policy violation; 3 malformed policy or input.
security_boundaries: expired or malformed suppressions fail closed
limitations: policy thresholds encode local risk decisions
compatibility_guarantees: mode names and baseline/suppression separation remain stable
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Policy modes cannot be repurposed during v1.x.
migration_notes: Preserve baseline and suppression files byte-for-byte when locally modified.

interfaces.summary: Extension manifest, kind, permission, lifecycle, and execution contract.
interfaces.exit_behavior: Unknown manifest fields, permissions, paths, or execution outcomes fail closed.
limitations: installed code remains a trust decision by the maintainer
compatibility_guarantees: manifest v1, kinds, permissions, and lifecycle states remain compatible
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Deprecated extension fields require an upgrade-plan migration note.
migration_notes: Installed and disabled states are preserved.

interfaces.summary: Agent contract, adapters, capabilities, safety rules, and task-pack identifiers.
inputs: repository context treated as untrusted data
outputs: deterministic guidance files and rendered tasks
interfaces.exit_behavior: Unknown fields, prompt boundary violations, or conflicts fail validation.
security_boundaries: prompt injection is treated as data
limitations: external agent behavior cannot be guaranteed
compatibility_guarantees: stable adapter and task IDs remain valid through v1.x
interfaces.deprecation_policy: An adapter or task must be marked deprecated with migration guidance before removal.
migration_notes: User-authored guidance files and disabled adapters are never silently overwritten.

interfaces.summary: Copyable profile templates, trusted integration workflows, and aggregate CI status.
inputs: explicit trusted-event configuration for live testing
outputs: sanitized artifacts and exact validate aggregate
artifacts: GitHub Actions artifacts documented per workflow
interfaces.exit_behavior: Every required offline job must succeed before validate succeeds.
security_boundaries: PR code is scan data only
limitations: live target and OIDC jobs are intentionally outside required PR execution
compatibility_guarantees: required status remains exactly validate in v1.x
interfaces.deprecation_policy: A distributed template receives migration guidance before incompatible replacement.
migration_notes: Local workflow customizations are reported as conflicts, never overwritten.

interfaces.summary: Versioned configuration files, environment variables, bundle layout, and strict parser boundary.
dependencies: strict JSON and bounded YAML readers
interfaces.exit_behavior: Ambiguous, oversized, duplicate-key, unsafe-path, or unknown-field input fails closed.
limitations: YAML support is limited to explicitly reviewed configuration boundaries
compatibility_guarantees: strictness and safe path rules may only become stricter for security fixes
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Configuration fields require documented migration before removal.
migration_notes: Unknown fields remain rejected where strictness is part of the contract.

interfaces.summary: Deterministic consumer bundle, SBOMs, readiness, manifest, provenance, checksums, and optional OIDC signature bundle.
interfaces.exit_behavior: Any missing, extra, mismatched, non-canonical, unsigned-when-required, or tampered artifact fails verification.
security_boundaries: external trust root for signature verification
no tags, releases, packages, or pushes
limitations: local preparation is checksum-verifiable but not publisher-authenticated
compatibility_guarantees: release artifact names and cross-verification semantics remain stable in v1.x
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Release artifacts require a major version for incompatible removal.
migration_notes: v1 readiness is preparation metadata and does not publish v1.0.

interfaces.summary: Machine-readable doctor, verification, upgrade-plan, and operation envelopes.
interfaces.exit_behavior: Status text and numeric exit category agree; errors are not represented as success.
limitations: human-readable output is not a machine contract
compatibility_guarantees: required envelope fields and status/exit distinctions remain stable
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Additive optional fields require explicit schema handling; removals require a major version.

interfaces.summary: Native, container, and auto portable-execution selection.
interfaces.exit_behavior: Unavailable modes fail closed with invalid input rather than silently changing execution.
security_boundaries: auto never selects an unavailable unreviewed runner
limitations: complete container profile runners are not yet published
compatibility_guarantees: mode names are retained while experimental; availability may expand
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Experimental availability can change with explicit release notes.

interfaces.summary: Honest host, runner, Docker, Windows, and GHES support claims.
interfaces.exit_behavior: Unsupported platform/profile combinations fail closed.
security_boundaries: no unsupported fallback download or emulation
limitations: native Windows is not supported or claimed
GHES compatibility depends on Node 24 action and OIDC availability
compatibility_guarantees: support is never claimed without a validated execution path
interfaces.deprecation_policy: Dropping a supported platform requires deprecation notice and a major version unless required by upstream security support.
